name: Zercher Carry
description: A loaded carry where the barbell is held in the crook of the elbows against the forearms in the Zercher position. This squat-like carry places tremendous demand on the anterior chain, upper back, and biceps. The low center of gravity and awkward position build functional carrying strength.

execution.starting_position: Set up for Zercher Carry in proper strongman position.
execution.setup_instructions: Prepare all equipment and body position for Zercher Carry.
steps: Step 1: Load barbell in rack at hip height. Cradle bar in elbow creases.
Step 2: Lift bar from rack and step back. Set feet at walking width.
Step 3: Walk with controlled steps keeping bar stable in arms.
Step 4: Maintain upright torso throughout the carry distance.
execution.breathing_instructions: Brace core maximally before every lift. Breathe between reps if needed.
common_mistakes: Letting the bar roll out of elbows
safety_considerations: Use collars on all loaded barbells.
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Full range of motion specific to the implement being used.
coaching_cues: Brace hard and keep torso tall
Pads on bar if elbow pain occurs
